goal: Write or update docs/PRD.md and docs/acceptance.json for the idea in docs/IDEA.md.

decisions.what: Scoped round 1 to the rule-based offline app: scan a folder for CSV/xlsx, classify columns, rule-picked line/bar/3D map charts, locally served assets, downsampling, one-click launcher
decisions.why: The brief's Asked and Done-when sections say exactly this; the AI, narration and export sections are superseded
decisions.evidence: docs/BRIEF.md Asked/Done when/Not asked; docs/IDEA.md L105-143

decisions.what: Treated docs/reference (deck.gl, unstructured.io) as captures of third-party libraries, not a business site; no redesign and no branding taken from them
decisions.why: Both are libraries named in the idea, not the client's website

decisions.what: Added an 'other' column type next to the four in the idea, and set fixed thresholds (≤50 distinct and ≤50% distinct for categorical, 90% date-parse for temporal, lng also geospatial)
decisions.why: Free-text and id columns fit none of the four, and the ACs need numbers to be testable

decisions.what: Kept the existing FastAPI + Jinja scaffold as the default stack and left the Flask/Dash choice to the architecture
decisions.why: The scaffold already exists; the idea's stack lines are prompts, not requirements

decisions.what: Made a cross-platform launcher command the Must item (AC-11) and Docker + Start-DataOS.ps1 a Should item (AC-13)
decisions.why: QA cannot run Docker or PowerShell offline in tests; the Windows packaging is still delivered
This is a browser dashboard web app

tried_and_failed.why_it_failed: The Bash command needed approval, which was not granted; the orchestrator will run it

assumptions: The drive is mounted as a normal folder; raw device access is out of scope
Bar charts sum the numerical column per category
A small count label ('showing N of M points') does not break the no-narration rule
Map renders with no online base-map tiles
open_questions: Branding: no logo, colours or fonts for the business were found. docs/reference holds only captures of deck.gl and unstructured.io (third-party libraries, with their own logos), which we will not use. Please confirm the product name ('Data OS', from Start-DataOS.ps1) and give a logo (image link in the gate comment) and colours/fonts, or confirm a plain neutral style.
Stack: the idea names Flask + Plotly Dash; the project scaffold is FastAPI + Jinja. Is the scaffold acceptable?
Is the launcher Windows-only (PowerShell + Docker), or must it also run on macOS/Linux?
Which file types beyond CSV and Excel are wanted next (JSON, PDF, Word, SQL, shapefile, GeoJSON)?
Are the PowerPoint/Excel report and Power BI exports dropped, or wanted in a later round?
Bar charts: sum or average per category?
Are the classification thresholds (categorical ≤50 distinct and ≤50% of rows; temporal ≥90% parse as dates) right, and are other chart types wanted?
Is a short count label or caption on charts acceptable, or must the dashboard hold no text beyond axis labels?

lessons.lesson: When docs/reference holds captures of libraries named in the idea (not the client's site), say so, don't spec a redesign, and ask for branding in the first open question
lessons.when: PM round where docs/reference exists for a non-redesign idea

lessons.lesson: check.py spec may need approval for Bash; validate JSON shape by hand and report it unrun
